The honest case for buying ZKEY now is weak, and I can't make a strong one.

What's in its favor: it's classed ORGANIC, not a factory coin. Its curve is spread out (top-3 share 7.7%, top-5 post-graduation buyer share 13%), it has 693 buyers, and the last 15 minutes show a positive return of about 10% with net buy flow of +2.0 SOL on $3.8k volume. It's still alive at 31 minutes.

What argues against it: the coin is down 83% over 30 minutes and sits 86% below its 30-minute high. The last 15 minutes had 70 sellers against 49 buyers and 14.8 SOL sold versus 16.8 SOL bought, so the recent bounce is thin and sell pressure is roughly even with demand. Sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation was 1.11, and a launch bot was present. A 10% bounce after an 86% collapse looks more like a dead-cat bounce than renewed demand. The pool is only 33.5 SOL deep, so a $20 ticket plus the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost leaves little margin for error, and a 30-second execution delay on a coin moving this fast is a real risk.

Verdict: there is no strong case that real demand is here and will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. I'd recommend skipping this one.
